package.name: vacuum_localization
package.description:
Stage 5 — Localization monitoring, quality estimation, and recovery for the Swachh Boudhik Yantra autonomous vacuum robot.
Nodes: localization_monitor — FSM: GOOD / WARNING / LOST based on AMCL covariance recovery_monitor — triggers recovery sequence when localization is LOST localization_metrics — 1 Hz CSV logging of pose quality and navigation stats
